model_annotation: This line chart, titled “Veterans as share of population,” illustrates the percentage of veterans within the total U.S. population from 1960 to 2010. The horizontal axis represents years, marked at regular intervals from 1960 to 2010, with no explicit scale type indicated but appearing linear. The vertical axis represents the percentage share, scaled linearly from 0 to 15%, with labeled tick marks at 0, 5, 10, and 15%. A single red line with circular markers connects data points, starting at 12.8% in 1960, rising to 13.8% in 1970, then declining to 12.1% in 1980, 11.0% in 1990, 9.4% in 2000, and finally 7% in 2010. The chart source is cited as the Census Bureau and Pew Research Center.
